title: Sr. Manager- Exports
description:
🌍 WE ARE HIRING \| SR. MANAGER – EXPORTS
 



 Vidya Wires Ltd. \| Anand, Gujarat
 



 Designation: Sr. Manager – Exports
 



 Location: Anand, Gujarat
 



 Department: Export / International Business Division
 



 Reporting To: Managing Director
 



 Experience: 15–20 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 


 🚀 About the Role
 
 Vidya Wires Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Sr. Manager – Exports to drive international sales, develop new global markets, acquire international customers, and strengthen relationships with existing customers, distributors, OEMs, and strategic business partners.
 



 The role will also support the international business development initiatives of ALCU Industries Pvt. Ltd.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Export / International Sales and Business Development, preferably from the Winding Wires, Copper \& Aluminium, CTC Conductors, Electrical, Cables, Metals, or Manufacturing industry.
 


 🌎 Key Responsibilities
 
 International Sales \& Business Development
 


* Develop and execute export sales strategies for international markets.
* Achieve annual export sales, revenue, and profitability targets.
* Identify and develop new countries, markets, customers, and business opportunities.
* Build and maintain a strong international B2B customer, distributor, agent, and channel network.
* Develop relationships with OEMs, importers, distributors, EPC companies, and industrial customers.
* Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and feasibility studies.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for new territories.
* Build a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent business conversion.



 Key Account Management
 


* Manage relationships with key international customers and strategic accounts.
* Understand customer requirements, specifications, forecasts, and future projects.
* Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contracts.
* Resolve customer complaints and escalations in coordination with internal teams.
* Drive customer retention, repeat business, and account expansion.



 Pricing \& Commercial Management
 


* Develop export pricing based on costs, market conditions, competition, freight, currency movements, and target margins.
* Prepare and negotiate commercial offers and long\-term supply agreements.
* Ensure commercially viable and profitable international business.
* Manage commercial aspects including Incoterms, payment terms, LC requirements, credit terms, freight, insurance, and claims.



 Export Operations \& Compliance
 


* Coordinate with EXIM, Finance, Logistics, Production, Planning, and Quality teams for smooth execution of export orders.
* Ensure timely documentation and shipment execution.
* Maintain knowledge of export documentation, international trade practices, Incoterms, LC terms, and applicable export\-import regulations.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, banks, customs, and other stakeholders.



 International Marketing
 


* Develop international market\-development and marketing initiatives.
* Identify and participate in relevant global exhibitions, trade fairs, conferences, and technical events.
* Support international customer presentations, product demonstrations, technical seminars, and promotional activities.
* Work with the marketing team to strengthen global brand visibility.



 Team \& Business Leadership
 


* Guide and mentor the export sales team.
* Establish KRAs and monitor sales performance.
* Develop regional representatives, agents, distributors, and channel partners.
* Provide international market insights to Production, NPD, Quality, and Management teams.


 🏭 Preferred Industry Experience
 
 Experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred:
 


* Copper \& Aluminium Winding Wires
* Winding Wires
* CTC Conductors
* Electrical Conductors
* Electrical Cables
* Power \& Electrical Products
* Copper / Aluminium Products
* Metals
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Manufacturing


 🎓 Qualification \& Experience
 * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Management / Marketing or related discipline.
* MBA in International Business / Marketing will be preferred.
* 15–20 years of relevant experience in Export Sales, International Sales, or International Business Development.
* Proven experience in developing international markets and acquiring global B2B customers.
* Experience managing OEMs, distributors, agents, and key international accounts.
* Strong understanding of export documentation, international commercial terms, and logistics.


 💡 Key Skills
 * International sales \& business development
* Global B2B customer management
* Market development and customer acquisition
* Commercial negotiation and contract management
* Export documentation and compliance
* Incoterms \& LC knowledge
* Distributor/channel development
* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Cross\-cultural business communication
* Strong execution and follow\-up capabilities
* Willingness to travel internationally


 📊 Key KPIs
 * Achievement of export sales targets
* International revenue and profitability growth
* New customer acquisition
* New market / country development
* Existing customer growth and retention
* Distributor and channel development
* Export order execution
* Gross margin improvement
* International brand and market development


 ✈️ International Travel
 
 The role will involve international travel for customer meetings, distributor/OEM meetings, exhibitions, trade fairs, technical seminars, negotiations, market development, and key\-account reviews.
 


 💰 Compensation
 
 Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives / bonus / commission, along with applicable benefits, healthcare, travel allowances, and coverage of approved international travel and business\-development expenses.
 


 📩 How to Apply
 
 Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with details of total experience, international markets handled, major customers developed, current designation, current compensation, expected compensation, and notice period.
 



 📧 Email: career@alcuindustries.com
 



 📞 Contact: 8511901679
 



 Subject Line:
 *Application – Sr. Manager – Exports* 




 📍 Location: Anand, Gujarat

title: Performance Marketing Manager

 . You should be comfortable leading weekly client meetings, presenting performance reports and recommendations, and managing the relationship.

* Develop and execute performance marketing strategies based on business goals.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across
 **Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant channels** 
 .

* Develop marketing plans and proposals that can be presented directly to clients.
* Analyze campaign and funnel performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage landing page, creative, audience, and A/B testing initiatives.

* Proactively identify opportunities to scale campaigns and grow client accounts.

**What We're Looking For** 



* **3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.**
* Strong experience with
 **Google Ads and Meta Ads** 
 ; LinkedIn Ads is a plus.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion funnels, and paid acquisition.
* Experience with GA4, conversion tracking, analytics, and performance reporting.
* Good understanding of metrics such as CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rate.
* Experience with landing page optimization and A/B testing.
* **Excellent communication and presentation skills.**
* Comfortable speaking directly with clients and leading performance review meetings.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to turn campaign data into clear business recommendations.
* Agency experience and B2B marketing experience are a strong plus.



  





  





**The Person We're Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who can
 **think beyond running ads** 
 .

**Understand the business → Create the strategy → Present it to the client → Execute campaigns → Analyze results → Recommend improvements → Grow the account.**

 On\-site

 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
 



**Website:**

**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
 



  





**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager\- Product Innovation \& Fabric Expert** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




  





  





**About the Role** 




 To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best\-in\-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Product Design \& Aesthetic Enhancement
 



  




* Review existing Covers portfolio and benchmark against global competitors.
* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.



  





 2\. Accessories \& Trim Innovation
 



 • Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
 



 o Buckles
 



 o Straps
 



 o Drawcords
 



 o Elastic systems
 



 o Velcro closures
 



 o Air vents
 



 o Handles
 



 o Reinforcement patches
 



 o Branding elements
 



  





 • Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
 



  





 3\. Fabric Research \& Development
 


* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter\-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category\-wise fabric strategy based on:



  





 o Weather resistance
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Water repellency
 



 o Breathability
 



 o Strength
 



 o Cost
 



 o Customer expectations
 



  





 • Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
 



 • Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
 



 • Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
 



  





 4\. Product Engineering \& Testing
 



  





 • Define performance standards for each category.
 



 • Conduct testing for:
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Waterproofness
 



 o Tear strength
 



 o Abrasion resistance
 



 o Color fastness
 



 o Weathering performance
 



  





 • Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
 



 • Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
 



  





 5\. Competitive Benchmarking
 



  





 • Benchmark leading brands in:
 



 o Outdoor covers
 



 o Furniture covers
 



 o Grill covers
 



 o Equipment covers
 



 o Automotive covers
 



  




* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.



  





 6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with:
 



 o Design Team
 



 o Sourcing Team
 



 o Manufacturing Team
 



 o Quality Team
 



 o Product Management Team
 


* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.



  





**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)** 




  





**Product Enhancement** 



* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category\-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.



  





**Fabric Development** 




  





 Identify and validate lighter\-weight fabric alternatives.
 



 Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
 



 Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
 



  





**Innovation Pipeline**

 Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
 



  





**Cost \& Value Improvement** 




  





 Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.

**Education** 




 • B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology
 



 • Technical Textiles

**Experience** 



* 10–15\+ years experience in:

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
